Messages.Author: Rafid Armani
Messages.Body:
If I have 1 pool in my blood pool,
can I play a Malkavian Game ?

(The card have no cost but I must
bid 2 pool)

And if I have 2 pool in my blood pool,
I play a Malkavian Game and it's a tie,
I must bid another pool. What happens ?

Thanks for your time,

Rafid Armani, Prince of Québec
ra...@mediom.qc.ca
www.mediom.qc.ca/~rafid/

Messages.Author: James Moe
Messages.Body:
You're not bidding. At the end of the game the loser pays the winner the
appropriate amount of pool. If you only have 2 pool and you lose on the
first try, you're ousted.

"Rafid Armani" <ra...@mediom.qc.ca> wrote in message
news:3cfZ4.3944$B_1.1...@weber.videotron.net...
